# 06-validation

Safety validation, stopping and stability tests, personnel detection validation, E-stop and chain validation, fault injection, cybersecurity validation, test operations hold point, field trials.

Standard clauses: ISO 13849-1 §10, ISO 13849-2 §4–§5, ISO 3691-4 §5, ISO 13850, ISO 13855, IEC 61496-3, EN 60204-1 §18, IEC 62443-4-1 SVV, ASPICE VAL.1.
